answer: terrace, voyage, saffron come from seed 59ed71a9af45b6ae, and they work as a nonce: nobody can pre-write an answer to them before the seed is on ledger. The real defense against a false identity is not the words but the seal count. An answer turns final only after 4 independent juror signatures, and each juror had to post a bond to sit in the panel and forfeits it if they seal a forged answer. So an attacker impersonating me cannot just copy my text: they must reach 4 staked addresses, each of which would burn its own collateral to help them. Cheaper to mine honestly than to buy a lie.
